enhancements.name: Eye of the Augurium
enhancements.description:
**GREY KNIGHTS** model only. You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

enhancements.name: Sanctic Reaper
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights Terminator^^** model only. Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Inescapable Judgement (Psychic)
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit Falls Back, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 2-5, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that enemy unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

enhancements.name: Nemesis Rounds
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights Terminator^^** model only.  Each time you target the bearer's unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+ while resolving that Stratagem.

enhancements.name: Paragon of Sanctity
enhancements.description: **^^Grey Knights^^** model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can select one friendly **^^Grey Knights^^** unit within 18" of and visible to it. If it does, until the end of the phase, that unit is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

enhancements.name: Phial of the Abyss
enhancements.description: **^^Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth ability.

enhancements.name: Mandulian Reliquary
enhancements.description: **^^Grey Knights^^** model only. While the bearer’s unit is not Battle‑shocked, add 3 to the bearer’s Objective Control characteristic.

enhancements.name: Radiant Champion
enhancements.description: **^^Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [^^**Precision**^^] ability, and while the bearer is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, each time a melee attack made by the bearer scores a wound, the target of that attack suffers 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage.

enhancements.name: Blinding Aura
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch ability to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Tome of Forbidden Ways
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. While the bearer is on the battlefield or in Strategic Reserves, add 1 to the number of units from your army that you can select for the Gate of Infinity rule.

enhancements.name: Banishing Wave (Psychic)
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer: on a 2-5, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 6, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Purity of Purpose
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up using the Deep Strike ability, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: One Foot in the Future
enhancements.description:
**GREY KNIGHTS** model only. When this unit ends an **ingress move**, you can use this ability. If you do:
- This unit can make a **normal move** of up to D6".
- Until the end of the turn, this unit is <ins>not</ins> **eligible to declare a charge**.

enhancements.name: Doomseer's Amulet
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit is set up in your Reinforcements step, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting one from that test.

enhancements.name: Grimoire of Conjunctions
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 4 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Shield of Prophecy
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Once per battle, at the start of the battle round, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the battle round, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Exigence
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. Once per battle, in your opponent's Shooting phase, when the bearer's unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack, you can remove the bearer's unit from the battlefield and then set it back up again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units. If the bearer's unit is no longer an eligible target, your opponent can then select new targets for any attacks that had targeted the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Driven by Duty
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights Walker^^** model only. Each time the bearer's unit Piles In or Consolidates, the bearer can move up to 6" instead of 3".

enhancements.name: Quickening Foci
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only.  In your Movement phase, each time the bearer's unit disembarks from a ^^**Transport**^^, until the end of the turn, you can re-roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: Spiritus Machina
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights Infantry^^** model only. In your Shooting phase, each time the bearer's unit is selected to shoot, if the bearer's unit disembarked from a ^^**Transport^^** this turn, until the end of the phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Pyresoul (Psychic)
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the bearer; that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Ephemeral Tome
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer's unit can make a Normal Move of up to D6" and, until the end of the turn, the bearer's unit is not eligible to declare a Charge.

enhancements.name: Sixty-sixth Seal
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only.  In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Sigil of the Hunt
enhancements.description: ^^**Grey Knights^^** model only. In your Shooting phase, each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Tactical Haruspexy
enhancements.description: Once per battle, when the bearer declares a charge, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, it can select units that are not visible to it as targets of that charge, provided they are within 9" of it.

enhancements.name: Sigil of Warding
enhancements.description: Once per battle, at the end of your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, it can make a Normal move of up to 3" and can then attempt to operate a Hatchway. The bearer is then not eligible to declare a charge this turn.

enhancements.name: Close and Sanction
enhancements.description: In your opponent's Shooting phase, each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot, after that unit has shot, if the bearer was hit by one or more of those attacks, the bearer can make a Dash move. To do so, roll one D6: the bearer can be moved a distance in inches up to the result, but it must finish that move as close as possible to the closest visible enemy unit. When doing so, it can be moved within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. The bearer can only make one Dash move per phase.

enhancements.name: Shield of Admonishment
enhancements.description: Each time a melee attack targets the bearer, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Psychic Celerity
enhancements.description: **TERMINATOR** model only. This unit has +1 to **charge rolls**.

enhancements.name: Vigilance of Titan
enhancements.description: **TERMINATOR** model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, you can select one **visible** enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **detection range**.

enhancements.name: Boons of Deimos
enhancements.description: **PURGATION SQUAD** unit only. This unit’s ranged attacks have +2 **S**.

enhancements.name: Precognicient Volleys
enhancements.description: **PURGATION SQUAD** unit only. This unit’s **snap shooting** attacks hit on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

enhancements.name: Predestined Coordinates
enhancements.description: **INTERCEPTOR SQUAD** unit only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **ingress move**.

enhancements.name: Astral Overlap
enhancements.description: **INTERCEPTOR SQUAD** unit only. This unit has **Stealth**.

stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.description: Re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, Advance roll, Charge roll, Desperate Escape test, or Hazard test.

stratagems.name: Counter-Offensive
stratagems.description: Interrupt the combat sequence immediately after an enemy unit has fought to fight with one eligible unit from your army.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.description: Your unit can arrive from Reserves as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, during your opponent's turn.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.description: Declare a counter-charge with one eligible unit after an enemy unit completes a charge move within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range after completing a Charge move; roll dice equal to your vehicle toughness and inflict mortal wounds on 5+.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within 8" and visible to this unit; roll six D6, each 4+ causes 1 mortal wound.
